# The Cell format in force — generated, do not edit

**Generated by `reference/gen_in_force.py`. CI fails if it is stale.**

The Cell spec is append-only, so it lives across several frozen files, each a
diff over the one before. That is right for history and useless for a newcomer:
to sign one Cell you would have to read all of them and work out what still
applies. This file answers only *"what must a Cell I create today satisfy"*.

It is **not** a spec. The frozen files are normative and this is derived from
running the code that enforces them — every rule below fired against a Cell built
by `reference/create_cell.py` and checked by `reference/validate_cell.py`. Nothing
here is transcribed, so nothing here can disagree with what CI does.

## In force right now

| schema | `crc.cell.v3` |
|---|---|
| mint commit (`CELL-v3.md`) | `c3678551cbc4` |
| enforcement commit (`reference/lineage_ref.py`) | `90233ad3a000` |
| activation commit | `c3678551cbc4` |
| activation rule | later(mint, enforce) by ancestry — v3 in force only when **both** landed |

v3 is in force because **CELL-v3.md is minted** and the **enforcement marker** is present — neither alone activates admission. The activation boundary is the **later** of the mint and enforcement commits by ancestry (same rule as `check_sunset.py` and `registry_id.schema_activation_commit()`).
Cells added after the activation commit must carry this schema. Everything older stands as
frozen history and is never re-signed or re-judged.

## The signed struct

EIP-712 `types.Cell`, in order:

```
  schema
  claim_id
  registry_id
  result
  verifier
  boundary
  as_of
  recomputed_at
  evidence_hash
```

On the Nostr lane the same payload is the signed `content` of a NIP-01 event.

## What a new Cell must satisfy

Every line below is a check that ran, in order, against a freshly created
`crc.cell.v3` Cell:

 1. strict parse, no duplicate members
 2. directory is a 64-hex claim digest
 3. filename is <node_id>.cell.json
 4. node registered in nodes.json
 5. node not retired
 6. cell shape {proof_payload, signature, verify}
 7. pre-hash gate on claim_preimage
 8. claim_id recomputes
 9. claim_id matches directory
10. schema is a known crc.cell version
11. registry_id == this registry (payload-primary)
12. EIP-712 struct carries registry_id
13. domain version is 3
14. v3 derived_from conforms (LINEAGE-REF.md §2)
15. as_of binding (payload == preimage)
16. recomputed_at present and a distinct field
17. boundary inside payload
18. evidence_hash recomputes
19. signature grammar ^0x[0-9a-f]{130}$ (65-byte hex, 0x-prefixed)
20. quadruple equality: recovered == signer == verifier == registered address

to verify a Cell that was signed under them.

## Making one

See [ONBOARDING.md](ONBOARDING.md). The short version:

```bash
export CRC_KEY=0x...
python3 reference/create_cell.py --claim claims/<id>.json --node <you> \
    --result GREEN --boundary "..." --evidence evidence.json
```
